content.text:
At 5, the move that works best is a slow fade rather than cold turkey: start by sitting next to his bed until he falls asleep, then over a week or two move yourself to the doorway, then the hall. Pair it with a simple wind-down routine he can name as "his" - same order every night - and a flashlight or nightlight so the room feels safe on his own.

Want the full night-by-night plan? Reply YES and I'll send it.
